story.tagline: SKYCOT builds AI employees that learn the job.
story.headline: AI employees that learn the job.
story.subheadline: SKYCOT agents perform real work, get evaluated, learn reusable skills, and improve over time.

weak_message.subject: Save 20 hours a week with AI employees
weak_message.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Quick question — how much time does your team spend on repetitive work?

AI employees can replace that across your whole business. Founders, ops, marketing — everyone gets time back.

Worth a 15-min demo?

Thanks,
Alex

before.agent_diagnosis: Generic messaging failed for technical founders. No verified company signal. Audience-flat ("everyone gets time back"). Single demo CTA without a low-friction fallback. The control variant landed at 0 positive replies on 100 sends — well below the 6%+ the variant cohort produced when anchored in the agent-learning-loop framing.

pattern.name: technical_founder_learning_moat_signal
pattern.summary: Across three reinforcing variant cohorts to technical founders at Series A-C B2B startups with an agent-platform GTM hypothesis, leading with the agent-learning loop and audit-chain visibility lifted positive-reply rate to 6-8% — well above the 0-positive baseline the latest 100-send control just produced. Pattern is reinforcing across 165 variant sends total.
evidence: cohort-01 — variant 6.0% positive · n=50 · agent-learning + audit-chain framing
cohort-02 — variant 7.0% positive · n=60 · refined low-friction CTA
cohort-03 — variant 8.0% positive · n=55 · anchored in verified company signal
counterexamples: Did NOT generalise to non-technical founders in the same employer segment — they replied at the control rate.

candidate.problem: Generic automation copy underperforms on outreach to technical founders building agent platforms. Without a reusable skill, every campaign re-derives this from scratch.
candidate.reusable_pattern: When the recipient is a technical founder at a Series A-C B2B startup AND the GTM hypothesis includes an agent-platform message, lead with the agent learning loop and audit-chain visibility. Anchor the message in one verified company signal (recent launch, hire, raise). Keep the body <=120 words. Single CTA. Do NOT use this skill for non-technical founders in the same segment.
candidate.expected_reuse: Per send to a matching prospect — ~30-50 prospects per quarter at current pipeline.
candidate.risk: Pattern may be specific to current market timing. Re-validate quarterly. Cap reuse at one send per account per quarter.

improved_message.subject: How does your team review the audit trail of your agent decisions?
improved_message.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Saw {{company}} shipped your agent platform last week — congrats.

When we talk to technical founders building in this space, the question that keeps coming up is: how do you review the audit trail of your agents' decisions before they ship to production? Most teams discover late that they need a learning loop where every action is reviewable.

If this resonates, I have a one-page reliability checklist I can share — no demo required.

Thanks,
Alex

after.why_improved: Anchored in one verified signal (the recent product launch). Led with the audit-chain framing — the discipline that lifted positive reply 4x across 3 prior cohorts. Single low-friction CTA ("share a checklist"), not a calendar grab. 96 words, under the 120-word cap the learned skill enforces.
after.projected_uplift: Based on the 3-cohort sample: +4-6 percentage points on positive-reply rate vs the generic control.
